facts.P1_fx_receipts: Probably freely; no restrictive currency controls are generally reported.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks offer foreign-currency (devizni) accounts to individuals.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register as an entrepreneur with APR online; tax and social security link automatically.
facts.L2_tax_id: JMBG for individuals; entrepreneurs get a 9-digit PIB.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Unregistered freelancers paid from abroad self-assess quarterly; entrepreneurs can use paušal.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 20% VAT above RSD 8 million in 12 months.
facts.L5_data_protection: A data protection law exists; details not confirmed yet.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.
facts.L7_incentives: Paušal: fixed monthly tax and contributions, up to RSD 6 million a year.

watch_out.text: Working for one client can fail the independence test and raise your tax.
Unregistered freelancers must file within 30 days after each quarter.
